<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 550" width="500" height="550">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Styles -->
  <style>
    text {
      font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 13px;
      fill: #000000;
    }
    .caption {
      font-size: 14px;
      text-anchor: middle;
    }
    .label-line {
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 0.8;
      fill: none;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Cliff (Left side) -->
  <!-- Vertical cliff face at x = 120, rock mass to the left -->
  <path d="M 120,50 L 120,450" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
  
  <!-- Hatch marks / shading for rock face (extending leftwards) -->
  <line x1="120" y1="60" x2="100" y2="70" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="90" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="120" x2="100" y2="130" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="150" x2="100" y2="160" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="180" x2="100" y2="190" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="210" x2="100" y2="220" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="240" x2="100" y2="250" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="270" x2="100" y2="280" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="300" x2="100" y2="310" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="330" x2="100" y2="340" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="360" x2="100" y2="370" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="390" x2="100" y2="400" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="120" y1="420" x2="100" y2="430" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Jagged rock top / anchor point region at top -->
  <path d="M 50,50 L 120,50 L 120,40 L 90,30 L 130,20 L 120,50 Z" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  
  <!-- Anchor point / peg at top -->
  <circle cx="120" cy="50" r="3" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Rope from top anchor (120, 50) to climber's hands (250, 230) -->
  <line x1="120" y1="50" x2="250" y2="230" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

  <!-- Climber (leaning back, side view facing left towards cliff) -->
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="270" cy="205" r="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Torso (leaning back at an angle) -->
  <path d="M 262,218 L 235,280" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" />

  <!-- Arms (reaching up and forward to rope) -->
  <path d="M 255,220 L 250,230" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" />
  <path d="M 235,280 L 250,230" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" />

  <!-- Legs (straight, extending from hips at (235,280) to feet against cliff at (120, 360)) -->
  <path d="M 235,280 L 120,360" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" />

  <!-- Feet pressed against cliff -->
  <path d="M 115,355 L 125,365" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Centre of Gravity (dot) -->
  <circle cx="205" cy="295" r="3.5" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Labels and Leader Lines -->

  <!-- Cliff label -->
  <line x1="85" y1="140" x2="60" y2="140" class="label-line" />
  <text x="52" y="144" text-anchor="end">cliff</text>

  <!-- Rope label -->
  <line x1="170" y1="120" x2="210" y2="100" class="label-line" />
  <text x="215" y="97" text-anchor="start">rope</text>

  <!-- Centre of gravity label -->
  <line x1="205" y1="295" x2="235" y2="340" class="label-line" />
  <line x1="235" y1="340" x2="265" y2="340" class="label-line" />
  <text x="272" y="344" text-anchor="start">centre of gravity</text>

  <!-- Rock climber label -->
  <line x1="265" y1="255" x2="310" y2="255" class="label-line" />
  <text x="317" y="259" text-anchor="start">rock climber</text>

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="250" y="490" class="caption">Fig. 2.1</text>

</svg>
